Usage: sink diff [OPTIONS] SERVER [FILENAME]

  Diff a local and remote file.

  FILENAME: file to be transferred
  SERVER: server name (defined in sink.yaml).

Options:
  -i, --ignore-whitespace        Ignore whitespace in diff.
  -d, --difftool                 Use meld instead of "git diff".
  -w, --word-diff [word|letter]  Refine diffs to word or letter differences.
  -h, --help                     Show this message and exit.
